notes: Vanilla lightning bolts, recorded by Java/LightningFixtures.java (CaptureFixtures=lightning) on a headless dedicated server in a flat world of air (plains) with the seed test-seed (the replay world's), frozen and stepped one tick at a time, with time, weather, mob spawning and random ticks off. Case i runs at origin (32i + 8, 64, 8), in a chunk of its own; positions are offsets from it. setup blocks are set without updates (pos, or a box from pos to to); entities are added without AI. difficulty is normal, fireSpread (fire_spread_radius_around_player) -1, spawnMobs false and mobDrops true unless a case says otherwise. A strike case seeds the level random with seed, summons a bolt at bolt whose own random is seeded with boltSeed (its seed and flashes drawn from it again, as its constructor does), with the listener as its cause (cause) or visual only (visualOnly), and steps ticks ticks. Each checkpoint holds, for that tick: writes (blocks stored in the area, in order, with flags), changes (the area's blocks that differ from the last checkpoint), entities (in the area, in the order they were added: type, offset, remaining fire ticks, health, persistence and what lightning changes), the sounds and levelEvents a spectator at (5.5, 10, 0.5) received, and the gameEvents within 16 blocks. Mobs' own randoms aren't seeded, so what they decide with them isn't recorded: ambient sounds, and a witch's drinking (its held potion, its entity.witch sounds and the game events it is the source of), and whether a zombified piglin a pig became holds a golden sword or spear; the villager cases run for 12 ticks, too short for a potion to finish. advancements are the lightning advancements that spectator was granted. A natural case runs ServerLevel.tickThunder once on the origin's chunk, raining and thundering unless it says otherwise, with the level random seeded and randValue set, and records the entities added, randValueAfter and the level random's next nextInt(), which shows the draws made.
